propositions: rebar must support customer-owned SSE-KMS-encrypted S3 buckets as ticket-store remotes via git-remote-s3, maintaining git event format and auto-commit/push semantics

concurrent pushes can corrupt the S3 backend by creating multiple bundle files for one ref, causing clone failures; rebar must fail closed with actionable messaging when the helper is missing or below minimum version
rebar must non-interactively self-heal multi-bundle corruption by merging divergent heads while preserving all commits and events, ensuring single-bundle state and fresh-clone success

operators must be able to configure the S3 backend from documentation alone, including optional dependency declaration, helper version requirements, bucket encryption setup, and sync.remote configuration
